rules.source: Law No. 09-08 (18 February 2009) and implementing Decree n° 2-09-165 (21 May 2009) — requires lawful, transparent processing, data minimization, and appropriate security; certain processing must be declared to or authorized by the CNDP (Commission Nationale de contrôle de la protection des Données à caractère Personnel), Morocco's data protection authority. https://www.clym.io/regulations/law-no-09-08-morocco
Law No. 09-08 — parental consent is required for processing a child's personal data. https://www.upsilon-consulting.com/en/cndp-law-09-08-personal-data-protection-morocco/

Law No. 09-08 — refusing a data subject's access, rectification, or objection rights carries penalties of MAD 20,000-200,000; failure to declare/authorize processing with the CNDP carries penalties of MAD 10,000-100,000. https://www.dpo-consulting.com/blog/morocco-data-protection-law-09-08
